chunks.title: App Router 基础
chunks.content:
# App Router 基础

App Router 是 Next.js 13 引入的路由架构，基于 React Server Components，使用 app/ 目录组织页面。它与旧的 pages/ 目录可以共存，但新项目建议统一使用 App Router。

chunks.title: App Router 基础 > 目录约定
chunks.content:
## 目录约定

app/ 目录下的文件夹映射到 URL 路径。app/page.tsx 对应根路由 /，app/about/page.tsx 对应 /about。文件夹嵌套形成路径层级，只有包含 page.tsx 的文件夹才会生成可访问的路由。

chunks.title: App Router 基础 > 特殊文件
chunks.content:
## 特殊文件

layout.tsx 是布局组件，包裹当前目录及子目录的页面，切换路由时不会重新挂载。template.tsx 与 layout 类似，但每次导航都会重新挂载，适合需要动画或重置状态的场景。loading.tsx 是基于 Suspense 的加载界面，在数据加载期间显示。error.tsx 是错误边界，捕获当前路由段的错误，必须标记为 Client Component。not-found.tsx 定义 404 页面。route.ts 是 API 路由处理器，对应旧的 pages/api。

chunks.title: App Router 基础 > 路由段与动态路由
chunks.content:
## 路由段与动态路由

用方括号创建动态段，例如 app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx 匹配 /blog/hello。page.tsx 通过 params 属性接收动态参数。在 Next.js 15 中 params 是 Promise，需要用 await params 取值。[...slug] 匹配多级路径，[[...slug]] 匹配零到多级。

chunks.title: App Router 基础 > 路由组与平行路由
chunks.content:
## 路由组与平行路由

(group) 语法创建路由组，不影响 URL，用于共享布局或组织文件。@slot 语法创建平行路由，允许同一布局中渲染多个独立区域，常用于仪表盘的侧边栏与主内容。

chunks.title: App Router 基础 > 拦截路由
chunks.content:
## 拦截路由

(.) 语法可以拦截路由，实现模态框等交互。例如从照片列表点击打开详情时显示模态框，而直接访问 URL 时显示完整页面。

chunks.title: 数据获取与缓存 > fetch 与缓存
chunks.content:
## fetch 与缓存

App Router 扩展了原生 fetch，默认强制缓存 force-cache。设置 cache 为 no-store 禁用缓存，每次请求重新获取。next: { revalidate: 60 } 表示 60 秒后重新验证。

chunks.title: 数据获取与缓存 > revalidate
chunks.content:
## revalidate

revalidate 是增量静态再生 ISR 的核心。页面在构建时生成，超过 revalidate 时间后，下次请求触发后台重新生成，期间返回旧内容。适合内容更新不频繁的页面。

chunks.title: 数据获取与缓存 > 动态渲染
chunks.content:
## 动态渲染

使用 cookies、headers、searchParams 或 no-store 会让路由转为动态渲染，每次请求在服务端生成。静态路由在构建时生成，动态路由在请求时生成。

chunks.title: 数据获取与缓存 > Server Actions
chunks.content:
## Server Actions

用 "use server" 定义服务端函数，可从 Client Component 直接调用，无需手写 API 路由。适合表单提交和数据变更。配合 revalidatePath 或 revalidateTag 刷新缓存。

chunks.title: 布局与页面 > 根布局
chunks.content:
## 根布局

app/layout.tsx 是根布局，必须包含 html 和 body 标签。Next.js 会自动创建这两个标签，但根布局中需要显式写出。根布局是 Server Component，可以设置全局 metadata。

chunks.title: 布局与页面 > 嵌套布局
chunks.content:
## 嵌套布局

布局可以嵌套。子布局接收 children prop，渲染在父布局内部。布局在导航时不会重新渲染，状态得以保留。例如仪表盘布局中的侧边栏在页面切换时保持选中状态。

chunks.title: 布局与页面 > Metadata
chunks.content:
## Metadata

用 export const metadata 定义页面元信息，支持 title、description、openGraph 等。动态路由可用 generateMetadata 函数根据 params 生成。title 支持模板，在父布局定义 title.template 为 %s | 站点名。

chunks.title: 布局与页面 > 页面组件
chunks.content:
## 页面组件

page.tsx 默认是异步 Server Component，可以直接 await 数据。动态路由的 params 和搜索参数 searchParams 在 Next.js 15 中都是 Promise，需要 await 后使用。

chunks.title: Route Handler API
chunks.content:
# Route Handler API

app/api/xxx/route.ts 定义 API 端点，导出同名 HTTP 方法函数：GET、POST、PUT、PATCH、DELETE、HEAD、OPTIONS。

chunks.title: Route Handler API > 基础用法
chunks.content:
## 基础用法

导出 async function GET 并接收 request 参数，返回 Response.json 即可生成 JSON 响应。POST 函数用 await request.json() 读取请求体，返回 Response.json(data, { status: 201 })。

chunks.title: Route Handler API > 动态参数
chunks.content:
## 动态参数

app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts 中，方法第二个参数包含 params。Next.js 15 中 params 是 Promise，类型是 Promise<{ id: string }>，需要 await params 才能取值。

chunks.title: Route Handler API > 流式响应
chunks.content:
## 流式响应

返回 ReadableStream 可实现流式输出，适合 AI 回答和大文件下载。在 start 回调中用 controller.enqueue 写入 TextEncoder 编码的字节，结束后调用 controller.close。返回 Response 时设置 Content-Type 为 text/event-stream，这就是常见的 SSE 模式。

chunks.title: Route Handler API > 注意事项
chunks.content:
## 注意事项

Route Handler 默认静态缓存，调用 request.json() 或使用动态 API 后转为动态渲染。可以用 export const dynamic = "force-dynamic" 强制动态。Route Handler 在服务端执行，适合放 API Key 等敏感信息，不会泄露到浏览器。

chunks.title: Server Components 与 Client Components
chunks.content:
# Server Components 与 Client Components

App Router 默认所有组件都是 React Server Component（RSC）。RSC 在服务端渲染，代码不会打包到客户端，可以直接访问数据库和后端资源。

chunks.title: Server Components 与 Client Components > Server Components 的优势
chunks.content:
## Server Components 的优势

零客户端 JavaScript 开销：组件代码只在服务端执行。直接访问后端：可以在组件中 await 数据库查询或文件系统操作。自动代码分割：只有 Client Component 才会进入客户端 bundle。更安全：API Key、数据库凭证不会暴露到浏览器。

chunks.title: Server Components 与 Client Components > 何时使用 Client Component
chunks.content:
## 何时使用 Client Component

需要交互和浏览器 API 时必须用 "use client" 标记，包括事件处理 onClick 与 onChange、React 状态与生命周期 useState 与 useEffect、浏览器 API 如 window 与 localStorage 与 Geolocation、以及多数第三方 React 库。

chunks.title: Server Components 与 Client Components > 组合模式
chunks.content:
## 组合模式

推荐把 "use client" 尽量下推到叶子组件。例如页面是 Server Component 负责取数，只把交互部分如按钮和表单拆成 Client Component，通过 props 传递数据。这样客户端 JS 最少。

chunks.title: Server Components 与 Client Components > 数据传递边界
chunks.content:
## 数据传递边界

Server Component 传给 Client Component 的 props 必须可序列化。函数、Date、Class 实例等不能直接传递。Server Action 是一个例外，可以作为 prop 传给 Client Component 并在服务端执行。

chunks.title: Server Components 与 Client Components > 注意事项
chunks.content:
## 注意事项

Server Component 不能使用 useState 与 useEffect，也不能绑定事件。Client Component 不能直接 import Server Component，但可以通过 children 传递 Server Component 渲染结果。

chunks.title: 流式渲染与 Suspense > loading.tsx
chunks.content:
## loading.tsx

在路由段添加 loading.tsx，Next.js 自动用 Suspense 包裹该段，数据加载期间显示 loading 界面。这是最简单的流式方案。

chunks.title: 流式渲染与 Suspense > Suspense 边界
chunks.content:
## Suspense 边界

手动用 Suspense 组件包裹异步组件，传入 fallback 属性实现局部加载。多个 Suspense 边界可以并行流式传输，快的组件先显示，不必等待慢查询。

chunks.title: 流式渲染与 Suspense > 流式服务端渲染
chunks.content:
## 流式服务端渲染

流式 SSR 让浏览器逐步接收 HTML，不必等所有数据就绪。用户感知更快，尤其适合慢查询场景。与整体渲染相比，首字节时间明显缩短。

chunks.title: 流式渲染与 Suspense > 错误边界
chunks.content:
## 错误边界

error.tsx 捕获子组件抛出的错误，显示降级 UI，必须标记 "use client"。提供 reset 函数重试渲染。global-error.tsx 捕获根布局错误。

chunks.title: App Router in Next.js 16
chunks.content:
# App Router in Next.js 16

The App Router uses the `app/` directory and React Server Components. In Next.js 16 it runs on React 19.2 and Turbopack is the default bundler for both `next dev` and `next build`.

chunks.title: App Router in Next.js 16 > Async Request APIs are now mandatory
headingPath: Async Request APIs are now mandatory

chunks.title: App Router in Next.js 16 > middleware renamed to proxy
chunks.content:
## middleware renamed to proxy

The `middleware` filename is deprecated and renamed to `proxy` to clarify its network-boundary and routing focus. Rename `middleware.ts` to `proxy.ts` and the exported function from `middleware` to `proxy`:

```ts
// proxy.ts (Next.js 16)
export function proxy(request: Request) {}
```

The `edge` runtime is **not** supported in `proxy`; its runtime is `nodejs` and cannot be configured. If you must keep the `edge` runtime, continue using `middleware`. Config flags were renamed too: `skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize` is now `skipProxyUrlNormalize`.

chunks.title: App Router in Next.js 16 > Turbopack by default
chunks.content:
## Turbopack by default

Turbopack is stable and enabled by default. Scripts no longer need `--turbopack`:

```json
{ "scripts": { "dev": "next dev", "build": "next build", "start": "next start" } }
```

If a custom `webpack` config exists, `next build` now **fails** to prevent misconfiguration. Use `next build --webpack` to opt out, or migrate the config. `experimental.turbopack` moved to a top-level `turbopack` key. Filesystem caching is enabled by default for dev and build.

chunks.title: App Router in Next.js 16 > Node.js and TypeScript requirements
chunks.content:
## Node.js and TypeScript requirements

Node.js minimum is now `20.9.0` (Node 18 is no longer supported). TypeScript minimum is `5.1.0`. Supported browsers: Chrome 111+, Edge 111+, Firefox 111+, Safari 16.4+.

chunks.title: Data Fetching and Caching in Next.js 16
chunks.content:
# Data Fetching and Caching in Next.js 16

Next.js 16 introduces Cache Components and stabilizes the caching APIs. `cacheLife` and `cacheTag` are now stable — the `unstable_` prefix is no longer needed:

```ts
// Next.js 15
import { unstable_cacheLife as cacheLife, unstable_cacheTag as cacheTag } from 'next/cache'
// Next.js 16
import { cacheLife, cacheTag } from 'next/cache'
```
headingPath: Data Fetching and Caching in Next.js 16

chunks.title: Data Fetching and Caching in Next.js 16 > revalidateTag requires a profile
chunks.content:
## revalidateTag requires a profile

`revalidateTag` now takes a second argument specifying a `cacheLife` profile. The single-argument form is deprecated and produces a TypeScript error. It uses stale-while-revalidate: readers see stale content while fresh data loads in the background.

```ts
revalidateTag('posts', 'max')
```
headingPath: Data Fetching and Caching in Next.js 16

chunks.title: Data Fetching and Caching in Next.js 16 > updateTag for read-your-writes
chunks.content:
## updateTag for read-your-writes

`updateTag` is a new Server-Actions-only API giving read-your-writes semantics. It expires and immediately refreshes data in the same request, so the UI shows the change right away. Use it for forms, settings, and workflows where users expect instant updates.

```ts
'use server'
import { updateTag } from 'next/cache'
export async function updateProfile(id: string, profile: Profile) {
  await db.users.update(id, profile)
  updateTag(`user-${id}`)
}
```
headingPath: Data Fetching and Caching in Next.js 16

chunks.title: Data Fetching and Caching in Next.js 16 > Partial Prerendering and Cache Components
chunks.content:
## Partial Prerendering and Cache Components

Partial Prerendering (PPR) is enhanced through Cache Components. The `experimental_ppr` Route Segment Config is removed by the upgrade codemod. Caching behavior is driven by `cacheLife` profiles (`default`, `seconds`, `minutes`, `hours`, `days`, `week`, `max`) and `cacheTag` invalidation.
headingPath: Data Fetching and Caching in Next.js 16

chunks.title: Layouts and Pages in Next.js 16
chunks.content:
# Layouts and Pages in Next.js 16

Layouts still wrap pages and preserve state across navigation: child layouts receive `children` and render inside the parent layout. A layout does not re-render on navigation, so state such as a sidebar selection is preserved. `template.tsx` remounts on every navigation, useful for animations or resetting state.

chunks.title: Layouts and Pages in Next.js 16 > Layout props are async
Layouts and Pages in Next.js 16 > Parallel routes need default.tsx
Layouts and Pages in Next.js 16 > Scroll behavior override changed (breaking change)
chunks.content:
## Scroll behavior override changed (breaking change)

Before Next.js 16, if you set `scroll-behavior: smooth` globally in CSS, Next.js temporarily overrode it to `auto` during SPA route transitions to keep navigation instant. In Next.js 16 this override no longer happens by default. To restore the old behavior add `data-scroll-behavior="smooth"` to your `<html>` element.

chunks.title: Route Handlers in Next.js 16
chunks.content:
# Route Handlers in Next.js 16

Route handlers live in `route.ts` and export HTTP method functions such as GET and POST. They replace the old `pages/api` convention.

chunks.title: Route Handlers in Next.js 16 > Route context params are async
Route Handlers in Next.js 16 > Server Actions and revalidation
chunks.content:
## Server Actions and revalidation

Server Actions (`'use server'`) run server code from the client. In Next.js 16, `revalidateTag` requires a second `cacheLife` profile argument:

```ts
// Next.js 15: revalidateTag('posts')
// Next.js 16:
revalidateTag('posts', 'max')
```

For read-your-writes behavior in a Server Action, use the new `updateTag` API, which expires and immediately refreshes data in the same request.

chunks.title: Route Handlers in Next.js 16 > next/image configuration changes (breaking)
chunks.content:
## next/image configuration changes (breaking)

`images.minimumCacheTTL` default changed from 60 seconds to 4 hours (14400s); set it back to `60` to restore old behavior. The value `16` was removed from default `images.imageSizes`. `images.qualities` now defaults to only `[75]`; unsupported `quality` props are coerced to the nearest allowed value. Local images with query strings now require `images.localPatterns.search` configuration.

chunks.title: Server Components in Next.js 16
chunks.content:
# Server Components in Next.js 16

React Server Components let you render on the server without shipping component JavaScript to the client. Next.js 16's App Router uses the React Canary channel including the newly released React 19.2 features.

chunks.title: Server Components in Next.js 16 > React Compiler support is stable
chunks.content:
## React Compiler support is stable

Built-in support for the React Compiler is stable in Next.js 16. The compiler automatically memoizes components to reduce unnecessary re-renders with no manual code changes. Enable it with the now-stable `reactCompiler` option:

```ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = { reactCompiler: true }
```

It is not enabled by default while build performance data is gathered. Enabling it raises compile times in dev and build because the compiler relies on Babel.

chunks.title: Server Components in Next.js 16 > Client Components still need 'use client'
chunks.content:
## Client Components still need 'use client'

Interactive components, event handlers, and browser APIs still require the `'use client'` directive. Server Components remain server-only by default. This distinction is unchanged from Next.js 15 — the major React change in 16 is the 19.2 feature set and optional compiler.

chunks.title: Server Components in Next.js 16 > Removed features
chunks.content:
## Removed features

AMP support is fully removed: the `amp` config key, `next/amp` imports, `useAmp`, and `export const config = { amp: true }`. The `next lint` command is removed — use Biome or ESLint directly, and `next build` no longer runs linting. The `eslint` option in `next.config` is also removed.

chunks.title: Streaming and Turbopack in Next.js 16
chunks.content:
# Streaming and Turbopack in Next.js 16

Streaming UI from the server still works through Suspense and the App Router — `loading.tsx` provides route-level streaming boundaries. Next.js 16 adds Instant Navigations (from 16.3) and performance improvements to `next dev` and `next start`, with clearer terminal output and better error messages.

chunks.title: Streaming and Turbopack in Next.js 16 > Turbopack is the default compiler
chunks.content:
## Turbopack is the default compiler

In Next.js 15, Turbopack was opt-in with `next dev --turbopack`. In Next.js 16 it is stable and used by default for both `next dev` and `next build`. Remove `--turbopack` from scripts. Use `--webpack` to opt out specifically for builds.

Turbopack File System Caching stores compiler artifacts on disk between runs and is enabled by default for dev and build, significantly speeding up recompilation after restarts.

chunks.title: Streaming and Turbopack in Next.js 16 > Build output metrics removed
chunks.content:
## Build output metrics removed

Next.js 16 removes the size and First Load JS metrics from `next build` output. The team found them inaccurate for server-driven React Server Component architectures. Use Chrome Lighthouse or Vercel Analytics to measure real route performance via Core Web Vitals.

chunks.title: Streaming and Turbopack in Next.js 16 > Concurrent dev and build
chunks.content:
## Concurrent dev and build

`next dev` now outputs to `.next/dev` while `next build` uses a separate directory, so both commands can run concurrently. A lockfile mechanism prevents multiple `next dev` or `next build` instances on the same project.

chunks.title: Upgrading to Next.js 16
chunks.content:
# Upgrading to Next.js 16

Next.js 16 was released in October 2025 (latest patch 16.4 in October 2026). Use the upgrade codemod or the agent CLI:

```
npx next@canary upgrade --agent=latest
pnpm dlx @next/codemod@canary upgrade latest
```

The codemod updates `turbopack` config, migrates `next lint` to ESLint CLI, renames `middleware` to `proxy`, removes `unstable_` prefixes, and removes `experimental_ppr`.

chunks.title: Upgrading to Next.js 16 > Breaking changes summary
chunks.content:
## Breaking changes summary

- Node.js minimum 20.9.0 (Node 18 dropped); TypeScript minimum 5.1.0
- Turbopack is default for `next dev` and `next build`
- Async Request APIs: synchronous `params`, `searchParams`, `cookies()`, `headers()`, `draftMode()` fully removed — always `await`
- `middleware` renamed to `proxy`; `edge` runtime not supported in `proxy`
- `revalidateTag` requires a second `cacheLife` profile argument; new `updateTag` API
- `next/image`: `minimumCacheTTL` default 60s → 4h; `16` removed from `imageSizes`; `qualities` defaults to `[75]`; local query strings need `localPatterns.search`
- Scroll behavior: `scroll-behavior: smooth` no longer overridden during navigation
- `next lint` command removed; AMP support removed

chunks.title: Upgrading to Next.js 16 > Breaking changes summary
chunks.content:
or: `scroll-behavior: smooth` no longer overridden during navigation
- `next lint` command removed; AMP support removed
- Async `id` for `sitemap`, async params and id for image-generating functions

chunks.title: Upgrading to Next.js 16 > New capabilities
chunks.content:
## New capabilities

Cache Components, stable React Compiler support, React 19.2, Turbopack File System Caching, Build Adapters API (stable in 16.2), Instant Navigations (16.3), lazy compilation and smaller Turbopack output (16.4).
